Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with severe abdominal pain radiating to the back

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 79-year-old female patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their first dose of DemoZanix (dose: 1 tablet twice daily) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-05-18.
Approximately 8 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe abdominal pain radiating to the back.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
M. Novak (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter666@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
